objective: Run eight alternating unmasked repair-SFT and fresh-ReLP mask-selection rounds, shrinking the zero-isolated arithmetic substrate while preserving behavior.

contract.intervention: At every MLP down_proj input, multiply every unselected channel by zero; attention, embeddings, norms, residuals, and selected channels remain live; no donor activations.
contract.recovery: masked_correct / dense_correct on the same records and same repaired model
contract.terminal_holdout_policy: Do not generate or score holdout records until all eight round decisions are frozen. At terminal evaluation, score all 2,000 pairs in compact and spaced formats, producing 4,000 prompt rows.

selection.selection_surface: A budget must pass both search-only calibration and the already-open development screen. Select the smallest passing budget no larger than the parent budget.
selection.stop_condition: Stop at the first round where the repaired dense model violates the dense floor or no candidate at or below the parent budget passes both recovery gates.

artifacts.teardown: Only after immutable upload listing and SHA-256 verification.
